foods.name: Apple Carrot Salad
foods.text: Crisp harmony of apples and carrots! A crunchy salad that lifts your mood. AGI +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

foods.name: Ascending Dragon Soup
foods.text: Spicy dish made with ‘dragon’ as its main ingredient; those who try it say it feels as though they start to ascend. VIT +9.

foods.name: Assorted Seafood
foods.text: A dish that evokes deep nostalgia for those born by the sea. Some say it brings tears to their eyes without warning. VIT +2.

foods.name: Assorted Shish Kebob
foods.text: Skewered dish made by grilling long, thin cuts of assorted meats. Popular for letting diners choose ingredients to suit their taste. LUK +7.

foods.name: Autumn Red Tea
foods.text: A tea blending three types of herbs to create a rich and harmonious fragrance. The taste itself is merely adequate. INT +2.

foods.name: Awfully Bitter Bracer
foods.text: Some say medicine becomes more effective as its unpleasant taste grows stronger, though such claims remain unverified. VIT +6.

foods.name: Bearfoot Special
foods.text: Dish counted among the greatest delicacies of Yongji Castle, said to be especially prized when made using the right sole. STR +8.

foods.name: Blessing of Yggdrasil
foods.text: Grants All Stats +7, ATK/MATK +30, and HIT/FLEE +5 for 1 hour.

foods.name: Blood Flavored Soda
foods.text: Carbonated soda loved by children for its sharp, fizzy taste. Slight hint of metallic flavor… but still enjoyable enough to overlook. LUK +9.

foods.name: Bomber Steak
foods.text: Looks like an ordinary steak, yet delivers an explosive burst of flavor the moment it's eaten. STR +3.

foods.name: Casual Stew
foods.text: A stew made by tossing in whatever the cook felt like adding. VIT +1 for 3 minutes. Recovers about 25 HP.

foods.name: Challenge Drink
foods.text: A drink that activates internal energy and greatly enhances ability. For 30 minutes, ATK/MATK +30, ATK/MATK +1%, HIT/FLEE +30, ASPD +1, SP consumption -5%, fixed casting time -30%. (% modifiers to fixed casting do not stack. Only the largest effect applies.)

foods.name: Chile Shrimp Gratin
foods.text: Gratin combining chili heat with savory shrimp—yet it tastes more like a spicy shrimp dish than a gratin. AGI +6.

foods.name: Chocolate Mousse Cake
foods.text: Signature chocolate mousse cake highly praised by royal dessert chef “Charles d'Orléans”, with a smooth texture and sweet, bittersweet flavor. DEX +2.

foods.name: Clam Soup
foods.text: Shellfish boiled to preserve the full ocean flavor. Both the broth and the Shell Meat are meant to be enjoyed. VIT +3.

foods.name: Cooked Nine Tail's Tails
foods.text: Payon specialty cuisine made from the tail of Nine Tail, widely regarded across Rune-Midgarts as a dish of good fortune. LUK +10.

foods.name: Cream Sandwich
foods.text: Light sandwich made with freshly baked bread filled with minced meat and cream cheese. Feels perfect as a lunch option. DEX +4.

foods.name: Dragon Breath Cocktail
foods.text: Liquor with a fierce flavor said to let you feel a dragon’s breath from a single sip. Those who taste it claim they can never forget it. INT +10.

foods.name: Flipper Salad
foods.text: A rare dish that may look unappealing at first, but opens the door to a whole new world once tasted. STR +2.

foods.name: Fried Grasshopper
foods.text: A simple dish even a Newbie can prepare. Tastes like fresh grass from an open field. STR +1.

foods.name: Fried Monkey Tails
foods.text: Monkey tail lightly stir-fried and simply seasoned. Rumored to be an extremely popular snack to go with drinks. LUK +1.

foods.name: Fried Scorpion Tails
foods.text: Dish made by stir-frying only the tastiest part, the Scorpion Tail. The hard shell is cracked to enjoy the tender flesh inside. Slightly poisonous, so eating too much is not good for the body. LUK +5.

foods.name: Fried Sweet Potato
foods.text: Dish made by deep-frying Sweet Potato and then simmering it with syrup. Crispy and sweet, making it a very popular snack. LUK +3.

foods.name: Fruit Mix
foods.text: Dessert made by cutting assorted fruits into bite-sized pieces and soaking them in syrup. Crisp texture is its greatest charm. DEX +3.

foods.name: Giant Burito
foods.text: A massive wrap seemingly made oversized on purpose so it cannot be eaten in a single bite. The creator’s intention is unmistakable. VIT +8.

foods.name: Grape Juice Herbal Tea
foods.text: A refreshing tea infused with grape essence and herbal aroma. Clears the mind—though it may simply taste like grape juice. INT +1.

foods.name: Green Salad
foods.text: Salad of healthy vegetables tossed in a sweet Umbala-style dressing. Latest wellness menu trend in Prontera. DEX +5.

foods.name: Heavenly Fruit Juice
foods.text: A juice described by every taster as giving the sensation of ‘soaring into the sky’. Proper fruit balance is said to be crucial. DEX +9.

foods.name: Herb Marinade Beef
foods.text: Marinated ribs enhanced with herbs, using a cooking technique passed down in Payon for added aroma. STR +4.

foods.name: Honey Grape Juice
foods.text: Special Grape Juice made by blending Grape Juice with nutritious honey. Sweet and pleasantly tangy. DEX +1.

foods.name: Honey Herbal Tea
foods.text: Herbal tea sweetened with honey for extra comfort. Handle with care—it’s served hot. INT +3.

foods.name: Hwergelmir's Tonic
foods.text: Liquor so revered that it was named after a legendary spring—the very source of all rivers. Everyone who tried it praised it endlessly. DEX +10.

foods.name: Immortal Stew
foods.text: Though its appearance and smell are rather unsettling, eating it is said to instill a strange sense of immortality. VIT +10.

foods.name: Incredibly Spicy Curry
foods.text: A fiercely spicy curry said to contain the ‘taste of endurance’. The key element is a pumpkin that strangely feels like it was once worn as a hat. AGI +8.

foods.name: Lucky Soup
foods.text: Dish said to bring extraordinary fortune only when eaten while fiercely hot. Then again… it may just be a rumor. LUK +6.

foods.name: Lutie Cold Noodle
foods.text: Dish where chill and spiciness blend in a delicate balance, with pumpkin used as a distinctive garnish. AGI +4.

foods.name: Lutie Lady's Pancake
foods.text: A sweet pancake crafted with the delicate touch of the Lady from Lutie. A taste that lifts the spirit. STR +5.

foods.name: Mastela Fruit Wine
foods.text: A distilled drink made from Mastela fruit refined solely for mental clarity. Best enjoyed in moderation. INT +5.

foods.name: Mixed Juice
foods.text: Mixed Juice made by skillfully blending various fruit juices. Getting the ratio wrong may send you into a whole new world. LUK +2.

foods.name: Morrcc Fruit Wine
foods.text: A fruit wine crafted by a Merchant from Morroc using tangy fruits. Light and enjoyable even for those unaccustomed to alcohol. INT +4.

foods.name: Peach Cake
foods.text: Refreshing cake made with Kunlun’s specialty peaches, known for their incredibly soft texture and fragrant taste. DEX +6.

foods.name: Premium Course Meal
foods.text: A premium dish made by condensing all dishes reputed to be good for the body. For 30 minutes, all stats +5, ATK/MATK +20.

foods.name: Red Mushroom Wine
foods.text: Wine made from aged grapes, yet said to taste completely different from regular wine. The secret is rumored to lie in the use of mushrooms. INT +6.

foods.name: Royal Family Tea
foods.text: A signature royal dessert by Charles d’Orléans, whose sweet aroma is said to drift beyond the castle walls during tea time. INT +8.

foods.name: Seasoned Jellyfish
foods.text: "Tentacle lightly cooked with squid ink and herbs. Looks delicious, yet the taste is unexpectedly subtle. VIT +4. --------------------------"

foods.name: Shiny Marinade Beef
foods.text: Grilled beef dish so exquisite that those who have tried it bestowed upon it the title of “Shining”. STR +6.

foods.name: Smooth Noodle
foods.text: Noodles with silky strands crafted by a master, so smooth they are almost difficult to eat. AGI +2.

foods.name: Soul Haunted Bread
foods.text: Sweet bread so intense that some say it feels as though one’s soul might fly away; others claim their tongue nearly melts. DEX +7.

foods.name: Special Meat Stew
foods.text: A specialty of the Dragon Castle region—slow-simmered assorted meats whose aroma spreads widely when the lid is opened. AGI +9.

foods.name: Special Royal Jelly Herbal Tea
foods.text: Herbal tea sweetened with Royal Jelly and honey, known to aid mental recovery, though its aroma is often considered unpleasant. INT +7.

foods.name: Special Toast
foods.text: Massive toast filled with meat, fruit, and cheese—about three times the usual amount. Despite the abundance, the taste remains uncertain. DEX +8.

foods.name: Spicy Fried Bao
foods.text: Spicy grilled dumplings with a stimulating aroma. Eating too many may lead to regret the next day. VIT +5.

foods.name: Steamed Alligator with Vegetable
foods.text: A recommended Umbala dish of lightly roasted crocodile meat wrapped with vegetables and steamed. Rumor says it is reserved for honored guests and cherished livestock. AGI +7.

foods.name: Steamed Ancient Lips
foods.text: Fish dish made by steaming freshly caught fish together with Ancient Fish Lips, believed to be good for health, wrapped in fragrant leaves. Said to be more popular among men than women. LUK +4.

foods.name: Steamed Bat Wing in Pumpkin
foods.text: Nourishing dish made by wrapping the mysterious ingredient Red Bat Wing in Hinalle leaves, then simmering it inside a hollowed pumpkin. Has a rather peculiar taste. AGI +5.

foods.name: Steamed Desert Scorpions
foods.text: A steamed desert scorpion dish considered one of the four great delicacies of the Sograt Desert, cooked using the heat of the sands. AGI +10.

foods.name: Steamed Tongue
foods.text: Finest-grade dish that is soft and delicious, with the only drawback being its expensive ingredients. Said to have also come from Yongji Castle. STR +10.

foods.name: Strawberry Flavored Rice Ball
foods.text: Rice ball with the refreshing flavor and aroma of strawberries. A rare experience that feels like eating strawberries as a side dish. LUK +8.

foods.name: Sumptuous Feast
foods.text: A curious dish said to bring tears as vivid mountains and blue seas unfold in your mind after eating it. VIT +7.

foods.name: Tendon Satay
foods.text: Top-quality tendons quickly grilled so the natural flavor of the ingredients remains intact. STR +9.

foods.name: Tentacle Cheese Gratin
foods.text: Gratin made by stuffing slippery Tentacle with sweet Sweet Potato and rich cheese, baked until golden. Its flavor seems slightly different from the well-known children’s snack. AGI +3.

foods.name: Tristan 12-Year
foods.text: Premium liquor crafted to commemorate the coronation of Tristan III, with the 12-year vintage considered the finest. INT +9.

foods.name: Whole Roast
foods.text: Large cut of meat grilled whole with spicy sauce. Said to be the ultimate dish for true meat lovers. STR +7.

foods.name: Yggdrasil Staff
foods.text: Staff that summons the Guardian of the World Tree, who bestows the Blessing of Yggdrasil. [Service Details] Provides 3 World Tree Dew each day, up to a maximum of 3 including those already carried. Available once per day. - Blessing of Yggdrasil: Consumes 1 World Tree Dew or Zelstar to grant a 1-hour buff. All HP/SP are restored the moment the blessing is received. All Stats +7 ATK +30, MATK +30, HIT +5, FLEE +5. Warning! Buff is removed upon death. Warning! - Yggdrasil Staff cannot be used in Memorial Dungeons (MD).

foods.name: [Quest] Premium Course Meal
foods.text: A supreme dish condensed from recipes rumored to be good for health. For 30 minutes: All State +5, ATK/MATK +20.
